title: edit should take an inline value, not only a file, stdin, or the editor
findings_note: dogfooding; a temp file per section edit

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
`slicer edit ID --section NAME` takes its body from `--file`, `--stdin`, or `$EDITOR`. For
a one-line section — a Git note, a short Implement — that means writing a scratch file and
pointing `--file` at it, or a shell heredoc into `--stdin`. This session that is 36 section
edits, most of them short, each with the temp-file dance. There is no way to pass the text
directly.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `edit ID --section NAME --text "one line"` sets the body to exactly that.
2. `prose edit REF --text "..."` does the same for a prose block.
3. `--text` is mutually exclusive with `--file`/`--stdin` (or a defined precedence), and an
   empty `--text ""` is handled deliberately.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Add `--text` as a fourth body source in `_body_from`, ahead of the `$EDITOR` fallback, for
both `edit` and `prose edit`. Decide precedence explicitly if more than one is given —
simplest is to reject the combination, matching how the tool refuses ambiguous input
elsewhere. A newline in `--text` is fine for a section body (unlike a one-line table
field), so no `_reject_bad_text` guard is needed here.

**Not in this slice:** multi-section edit in one call, or `edit --append` (S17). This is
just a fourth source for the single-section edit that already exists.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Verified both edit commands with exact inline text, empty and whitespace-only bodies, multiline and trailing-newline values, conflicting inputs, file/stdin compatibility, editor fallback and abort, prose no-op behavior, and --render. Seven focused tests passed, including parameterized scenarios. A smoke test using the installed slicer passed. Full suite: 450 tests, 446 passed, 1 skipped, 3 known workspace-local temporary-directory failures tracked in S54. slicer check and git diff --check pass. Parser failures outside the error envelope are tracked separately in S53.
